briefing: Markets pulled back today with NASDAQ down 1.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.6%, a clear risk-off signal. No new candidates were available to screen, so we're holding our 7 existing positions and keeping the remaining cash in reserve rather than forcing a buy.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and move toward safety, often shown by tech-heavy indices like the NASDAQ falling more than broader markets. The right move on these days is usually to hold steady and avoid chasing new positions until conditions improve.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」(Risk-Off) 指投資者普遍賣出成長股等風險較高的資產，轉向較安全的資產，通常表現為科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌幅大於大盤。在這種日子，較正確的做法通常是按兵不動,等待市場環境改善後再考慮新的投資。

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit tech-heavy indices harder than the general market today, with the NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500 by roughly double the decline. This pattern typically reflects profit-taking or risk aversion concentrated in higher-beta growth names rather than a single company-specific catalyst. No specific news headlines were available to confirm the exact driver today.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍遭拋售，科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌幅是標普500指數的兩倍左右，顯示資金從高波動成長股撤出的避險情緒較為明顯，而非單一個股消息所致。目前未有具體新聞標題可確認今日下跌的確切原因。
